subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the 14 executable action revisions be accepted as one reviewed security-sensitive batch after refresh and exact-head checks, or should credential-bearing and publishing actions be split for separate review?
rationale: The patch is mechanically sound, but it changes third-party code that receives secrets and controls security scanning, publishing, token minting, and agent execution; repository intent is required for the acceptable review boundary.

options.title: Approve the refreshed batch
options.body: Review the upstream revisions together, refresh onto current main, and merge after all affected exact-head checks pass.

options.title: Split sensitive actions
options.body: Separate token, Codex, CodeQL, Docker login, and publishing revisions from routine toolchain and labeling updates for narrower reviews.

options.title: Pause the update
options.body: Keep the existing immutable revisions until maintainers can audit the grouped upstream changes and their workflow contracts.

recommendation.title: Approve the refreshed batch
recommendation.body: Review the upstream revisions together, refresh onto current main, and merge after all affected exact-head checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history and PR timeline most strongly connect this person to the repository's workflow and security-boundary decisions.
